systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Subcritical Water Dynamic Multi-Stage Counter-Current Extraction & In-Line Polyphenol Fractionation (SCW-MCC) Industrial Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous High-Pressure Subcritical Hydrothermal Extraction Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / USDA Organic 7 CFR Part 205 / EU 2018/848 Organic Certified / 3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 & 08-17 / EHEDG Type EL Class I CIP / ASME Section VIII Div 1 & B31.3 Sanitary High-Pressure Piping)
systemArchitectures.technology: Continuous pressurized hot subcritical water (T = 110–190°C, P = 25–60 bar) dynamic multi-stage counter-current column extraction coupled with in-line tubular ceramic nanofiltration (TiO2/ZrO2, 200–500 Da MWCO, 15–30 bar TMP) for solvent-free, single-step extraction, clarification, and 4x–8x volumetric concentration of polyphenols, proanthocyanidins, and flavonoids with >94% recovery and zero organic solvent residues.
systemArchitectures.ceramicMembraneMwcoDa: 200 – 500 Da (TiO2 on α-Al2O3 Support, pH 0–14, T up to 250°C)
systemArchitectures.specificThermalEnergySecKwhPerKg: 0.22 – 0.38 kWh/kg extract (utilizing 82% regenerative economizer heat recovery)
systemArchitectures.cipSanitizationRating: 100% Electropolished 316L/Hastelloy C-276 (Ra < 0.38 µm), EHEDG Type EL Class I CIP validated

formulations.name: Red Grape Pomace Anthocyanins & Proanthocyanidins
formulations.formulationDescription: Milled organic Pinot Noir and Cabernet winery pomace (skins and seeds) rich in malvidin-3-glucoside, polymeric proanthocyanidins, and trans-resveratrol.
formulations.degradingAlternative: Batch Soxhlet Extraction with 70% Aqueous Ethanol (4.5 hours reflux at 85°C leading to 32% thermal oxidation of anthocyanin monoglucosides, high explosive solvent recovery costs, and solvent waste disposal)
formulations.regulatoryStandard: USDA Organic 7 CFR Part 205 & FDA 21 CFR § 117 (FSMA cGMP)

formulations.name: Olive Mill Pomace & Leaf Oleuropein & Hydroxytyrosol
formulations.formulationDescription: Upcycled two-phase olive mill pomace and leaves concentrated in secoiridoid oleuropein, hydroxytyrosol, and tyrosol for clean-label cardiovascular supplements.
formulations.degradingAlternative: Methanol-Water Extraction (toxic residue hazards requiring rigorous rotary evaporation, non-organic compliant, and generating dangerous volatile organic carbon vapors)
formulations.regulatoryStandard: EU 2018/848 Organic Regulation & EFSA Article 13.2 Polyphenol Claim Compliant

formulations.name: Citrus Peel Nobiletin, Hesperidin & Polymethoxyflavones
formulations.formulationDescription: Cold-pressed orange and mandarin peel flavedo containing hydrophobic polymethoxyflavones (nobiletin, tangeretin) and flavanone glycosides (hesperidin).
formulations.degradingAlternative: Supercritical CO2 with 20% Ethanol Co-Solvent (requires high-pressure autoclaves >350 bar with batch loading, complex dual-fluid phase recycling, and low hesperidin solubility)

formulations.name: Green Tea Epigallocatechin Gallate (EGCG) & Catechins
formulations.formulationDescription: First-flush Camellia sinensis tea leaves extracted for native un-epimerized (-)-epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) and (-)-epicatechin (EC).
formulations.degradingAlternative: Boiling Hot Water Atmospheric Steeping (100°C for 60 min, resulting in 42% epimerization of active EGCG into inactive gallocatechin gallate [GCG] and extensive polyphenol-protein haze precipitation)
formulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA 21 CFR § 117 & USP Monograph for Green Tea Extract

formulations.name: Wild Elderberry & Blackcurrant Cyanidin Glycosides
formulations.formulationDescription: Deep-purple berry pomace residue packed with cyanidin-3-sambubioside and delphinidin-3-rutinoside natural colorants and immune-modulating bioactives.
formulations.degradingAlternative: Sulfited Acidified Water Extraction (residual SO2 allergen contamination requiring chemical desulfitation and stripping)
formulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA Color Additive 21 CFR § 73 & USDA Organic

formulations.name: Pyrolysis Caramelization, HMF Formation & Membrane Fouling Hazard
formulations.formulationDescription: Hazard baseline simulation: excessive temperature (>215°C), low pressure permitting steam cavitation (P < 25 bar), prolonged residence time (>25 min), resulting in carbohydrate pyrolysis into 5-HMF, polyphenol ring breakdown, and irreversible ceramic membrane pore plugging by humins.
formulations.degradingAlternative: Severe pyrolytic degradation, caramelization of free pentoses/hexoses, toxic 5-HMF formation (>150 ppm), and total loss of antioxidant biological activity
formulations.regulatoryStandard: NON-COMPLIANT: Exceeds EU Regulation (EU) 2017/2158 Contaminants & FDA Food Safety Limits
